step_name: Pre-Operational Verification, Discovery Reconciliation, and Technical Readiness Gate

subprocess_flow.description: Upon physical installation and network connection on the dedicated staging subnet, ServiceNow ITOM Discovery initiates a targeted credentialed deep-scan across management controllers (iLO/iDRAC) and operating system instances. The discovery pattern extracts granular configuration data including CPU core counts, memory module serials, disk topologies, HBA WWNs, NIC MAC addresses, and active firmware revisions. The resulting payload is parsed and staged in the ServiceNow Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE) pipeline for baseline matching.
inputs: Data Centre Cabling Schedule and Elevation Plan
Staging Subnet IP Range and Credential Profile
dependencies: Data Centre Migration Staging, Rack-and-Stack, and Initial Discovery
success_criteria: ITOM Discovery deep-scan successfully interrogates all physical components and returns zero discovery errors.
subprocess_flow.purpose: Capture the full physical and logical configuration inventory of staged hardware prior to production traffic ingestion.
subprocess_flow.scope: Staged compute, storage, and networking hardware within target data centre halls prior to production gating.
triggers: Completion of physical rack-and-stack and OS/hypervisor installation on staging hardware.
end_conditions: Raw discovered inventory payload is populated in ServiceNow IRE staging tables.

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Incomplete discovery scan due to firewall port blocks or credential failure leaving hidden hardware configurations undocumented.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated discovery error detection script that flags incomplete scans and halts workflow progression until credentialed sweep completes at 100%.

change_management.change_request_process: Scan initiated under the existing Migration Change Request (CHG) work task schedule.
change_management.versioning_rules: Discovery pattern versions managed under ServiceNow ITOM release governance.

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Validate HAM and CMDB Bidirectional Linkage
subprocess_flow.description: The IRE executes automated bidirectional synchronization checks between the physical asset table (alm_hardware) and the configuration database (cmdb_ci_hardware). The sub-step asserts that the serial number, bank asset tag, and MAC address match precisely between both tables, confirming the asset is in install_status='In Stock' and substatus='Reserved for Migration', and that cmdb_ci_hardware reflects install_status='In Stock / Staging' with operational_status='Non-Operational' (2). Any missing foreign key linkage or orphaned asset stub causes an immediate pipeline halt.
outputs: Bidirectionally Linked alm_hardware and cmdb_ci_hardware Records
success_criteria: 100% bidirectional synchronization between alm_hardware and cmdb_ci_hardware with zero foreign key mismatch or orphaned records.
subprocess_flow.purpose: Ensure tight alignment between financial asset ownership records and technical configuration data models.
subprocess_flow.scope: All hardware assets allocated to the current data centre migration wave.
triggers: Ingestion of deep-scan CI payload into ServiceNow IRE staging tables.
end_conditions: Asset and CI records verified as 100% synchronized and bidirectionally linked.

step_risks_and_controls.risk: De-synchronized asset and CI statuses creating audit blindness and regulatory reporting discrepancies.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Mandatory ServiceNow IRE reconciliation script that halts workflow execution if the CI-to-Asset 1:1 foreign key binding is broken.

change_management.change_request_process: Asset attribute alignment remediated under standard asset update protocols.
change_management.versioning_rules: Asset audit ledger logs every attribute synchronization event with timestamp and system user ID.

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Reconcile Attributes Against Target Architecture Baseline
subprocess_flow.description: Discovered hardware attributes (CPU processor models, core counts, RAM density, storage volume capacities, RAID controller settings, HBA WWNs, PDU circuit feeds, and rack U-position) are programmatically compared against the Target Technical Architecture Baseline Specification stored in ServiceNow. Discrepancies between installed hardware components and the engineered build blueprint are flagged. If variance is identified, a Drift Discrepancy Log is generated and linked directly to the Migration Change Task.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Physical Deployment and Migration Engineering Lead
inputs: Data Centre Cabling Schedule and Elevation Plan
dependencies: Validate HAM and CMDB Bidirectional Linkage
success_criteria: Hardware configuration matches approved architectural specification across all mandatory attributes with 0 unapproved variances.
subprocess_flow.purpose: Verify that physically provisioned hardware conforms precisely to engineering design and resilience specifications.
subprocess_flow.scope: Physical and logical hardware components of compute nodes, chassis, and attached fabrics.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: Physical Deployment and Migration Engineering Lead
triggers: Validation of bidirectional asset-to-CI linkage in ServiceNow.
end_conditions: Baseline reconciliation scorecard generated, logging zero variance or routing drift logs to engineering.

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Incorrect memory sizing or unapproved CPU variants deployed, causing failure of low-latency trading algorithms or cluster imbalance.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated baseline comparison engine that fails the technical gate if hardware attributes diverge from target design specifications.

governance_requirements: PRA SS1/21 Operational Resilience Infrastructure Governance

change_management.change_request_process: Hardware modifications to correct drift require Change Task update authorized by Migration Lead.
change_management.versioning_rules: Engineering blueprints versioned under Architecture Control Board (ACB).

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Verify Firmware Compliance and Security Baselines
subprocess_flow.description: The configuration items' microcode and firmware versions (BIOS, UEFI, BMC/iLO, RAID controller, and NIC/HBA firmware) are audited against the bank's approved security firmware matrix. Hardware components running unapproved, outdated, or vulnerable firmware revisions are flagged for immediate automated or manual flashing. Security configurations such as Secure Boot enforcement, default credential resets, and Out-of-Band management encryption are formally attested.
dependencies: Reconcile Attributes Against Target Architecture Baseline
success_criteria: 100% of firmware and microcode versions match the approved banking security baseline.
subprocess_flow.purpose: Ensure hardware firmware satisfies rigorous cyber security and stability standards prior to network enablement.
subprocess_flow.scope: All embedded microcode, BIOS, and management controllers across staged equipment.
triggers: Successful attribute baseline reconciliation scorecard approval.
end_conditions: Firmware versions verified compliant with signed digital attestation logged in ServiceNow.

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Hardware with firmware vulnerabilities introduced into live environment, breaching security standards and exposing trading networks.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated gate validation script blocking promotion of any CI with non-compliant firmware hashes or versions.

governance_requirements: FCA SYSC 15.9 Operational Risk Systems and Controls

change_management.change_request_process: Firmware upgrades executed strictly under authorized Change Tasks before operational cutover.
change_management.versioning_rules: Microcode baselines maintained in ServiceNow HAM Pro Firmware Library.

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Execute Automated CMDB Health Rules and Attestation
subprocess_flow.description: ServiceNow Health Engine assesses the discovered hardware CI against enterprise CMDB Health KPIs: Completeness (100% of mandatory fields populated including rack position, serial, model, support group), Correctness (zero duplicate serials, valid relationships, IRE compliance), and Compliance (adherence to naming standards and domain separation). The health score is aggregated; the aggregate score must reach or exceed 99.5% to comply with FCA PS21/3 data integrity requirements. The Lead Configuration Manager reviews and signs the automated attestation report.
outputs: ServiceNow CMDB Health Attestation Report (Correctness, Completeness, Compliance)
dependencies: Verify Firmware Compliance and Security Baselines
success_criteria: Overall CMDB Health scorecard achieves >99.5% compliance across Completeness, Correctness, and Compliance dimensions.
subprocess_flow.purpose: Quantify and formally attest that CMDB data integrity satisfies FCA PS21/3 resilience benchmarks before production authorization.
subprocess_flow.scope: All staged hardware CIs and their logical dependencies targeted for migration cutover.
triggers: Successful completion of firmware compliance and security baselining.
end_conditions: CMDB Health Audit Certification (>99.5% compliance) is digitally generated and signed in ServiceNow.

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Sub-threshold CMDB data quality compromising dependency visibility during major incidents or disaster recovery.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Hardcoded ServiceNow business rule preventing workflow clearance if CMDB Health score is below 99.5%.

governance_requirements: FCA Policy Statement PS21/3 Data Integrity Verification

change_management.change_request_process: CMDB Health rule adjustments require CCB and Configuration Manager authorization.
change_management.versioning_rules: CMDB Health scoring policies versioned within ServiceNow Configuration Management.

subprocess_flow.description: Upon successful validation of CMDB Health (>99.5%), asset-to-CI bidirectional linkage, architectural conformance, and firmware compliance, the ServiceNow workflow engine automatically generates an immutable Pre-Operational Technical Readiness Clearance Token. This cryptographically verified token is affixed to the CI record and linked to the pending Production Cutover Change Request (CHG). The state remains locked at 'Build / Pre-Production' and operational_status='Non-Operational' (2), awaiting formal CAB production cutover authorization.
inputs: ServiceNow CMDB Health Attestation Report (Correctness, Completeness, Compliance)
outputs: Automated Technical Readiness Clearance Token in ServiceNow
Automated Pre-Operational Technical Readiness Gate Clearance
dependencies: Execute Automated CMDB Health Rules and Attestation
success_criteria: Automated Technical Readiness Clearance Token generated and recorded in ServiceNow, unblocking CAB agenda scheduling.
subprocess_flow.purpose: Provide a secure, auditable prerequisite token that permits the Change Advisory Board to evaluate the CI for live production promotion.
subprocess_flow.scope: All staged hardware CIs passing technical gate criteria.
triggers: Generation and sign-off of CMDB Health Audit Certification exceeding 99.5% accuracy.
end_conditions: Technical Readiness Clearance Token recorded in ServiceNow CI record, enabling subsequent CAB Operational Approval Gate.

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Bypassing technical validation gates through manual database manipulation or improper workflow overrides.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Read-only cryptographically stamped token generated by automated workflow; manual overrides trigger high-severity audit alerts.

governance_requirements: FCA PS21/3 Operational Resilience Audit Trail
ITIL 4 Change Enablement and Service Configuration Management

change_management.change_request_process: Token injection automatically updates the pending Production Change Request (CHG) status to 'Ready for CAB Review'.
change_management.versioning_rules: Token issuance permanently recorded in the immutable ServiceNow CI lifecycle history ledger.
